thread:
Anya: FYI noticed a bunch of customer complaints: our sampleapp surfaces different error shapes between SDKs and the copy is scary.

MattG: which SDKs/endpoints? any repro steps?

Anya: repro on generate + embeddings. python gives a ServerError with a tiny dict: {'code': 'server_error', 'message': 'internal error'}. js just throws Error('500'). No structured fields in the JS error.

Sarah-L: that's a UX disaster. We need a single minimal error envelope across SDKs: code (enum), http_status, message, hint, retryable (bool), error_id. Makes frontends deterministic.

Kai: +1. My mapping suggestion: 429 -> RATE_LIMIT (retryable, include retry_after), 502/503/504 -> TRANSIENT_SERVICE (retryable), 5xx originating from model runtimes -> INTERNAL_MODEL (non-retryable). Add transient boolean and a short human_action hint like 'try again in 30s' or 'contact support with error_id'.

Anya: also the sampleapp prints full stacktrace into the public UI. we should show a concise friendly string to end users and put full trace behind a developer toggle.

Dev-bot: created issue #4589: "unify SDK error envelope + sampleapp UX" https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/4589 :eyes:

MattG: quick tech checklist for PRs:
- js: Error subclass with fields {code, http_status, message, hint, retryable, error_id}
- py: typed exceptions (RateLimitError, TransientServiceError, InternalModelError) with attributes and __str__ friendly output
- sampleapp: swap public UI to friendly_message and add collapsible dev view showing error_id + stack
- add telemetry emit for error_id & code
- unit tests: map 429 -> RateLimitError, 502 -> TransientServiceError; ensure retry middleware reads retryable flag

Sarah-L: add an integration test that the UI only shows friendly_message by default and that error_id is present in logs. Also, confirm we don't leak stack + PII to the UI.

Kai: i'll take the python exceptions + backend logging. i'll ensure the exception objects serialize to JSON with the minimal envelope for the server-side API.

MattG: i'll own the JS client and sampleapp UI changes. will add a small shim that normalizes error shapes from network layer into the Error subclass.

Anya: one more nit: please include stable error codes (snake_case enum) not just raw HTTP. Frontend teams want invariants for copy matching.

Sarah-L: can we also add a short fallback for unknown errors: code UNKNOWN_ERROR, http_status=500, retryable=false, message 'Something went wrong' and error_id provided. That lets product show reasonable copy.

Dev-bot: linked PR checklist created in issue #4589 with tasks and assignees.

Kai: timeline?

MattG: aiming for small PRs today: js shim + tests; Anya/Kai will land python + sampleapp tomorrow.

Anya: perfect. thanks everyone :rocket:
